Original Actions artifact digest is recorded from authenticated GitHub metadata; download-artifact validates its own archive digest. This exporter independently verifies every original package against its frozen build manifest and records artifact identity; it does not claim a second local hash of the outer Actions ZIP.
Files at or above 100000000 bytes stay in the original Actions artifact with its expiry; preserving a reference is not permanent package publication or QA completion.
Only future builds using the changed workflow retain packages after failed QA. Previously skipped uploads do not create recoverable original bytes.
